title: Realization of represented higher proper ind-image
statement: Fix D,l≠D.p,Ω and finite-type k₀-schemes X₀,Y₀ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let p₀:X₀→Y₀ be proper and p its geometric base change [def-zl-weil-geometric-fiber-properties]. Let S be any normalized compact-support coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] for (id,p). For n∈ℕ, constructible Weil sheaves G on X₀ and H on Y₀ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and any isomorphism e:y_Y(H)≅Rⁿp_*(y_X(G)) in the specified ambient equivariant ind-category [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], H.carrier is isomorphic to the standard truncation cohomology Hⁿ(S(G.carrier)) [def-weil-constructible-heart]. No open extension, general compactification or input integral representative occurs. Schemes need not be absolutely separated.

source.document: SGA 4, XVII, proper direct image; Bhatt–Scholze 6.8.14–6.8.15; Barrett, The derived category of the abelian category of constructible sheaves, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2005.10859, Theorem 1.1; Kashiwara–Schapira, Categories and Sheaves, §15.3
source.place: Ordinary-heart realization, exact Yoneda on bounded derived categories, proper-image adjunction and coefficient transport.

proof.text: Apply the existence/comparison theorem for the proper higher image to obtain a represented object H₀, its ind-image isomorphism, and the normalized cohomology carrier isomorphism.
Use full faithfulness of the Weil embedding to transport the carrier isomorphism from H₀ to the supplied representative H along the given ind-image isomorphism.

theorem zlIndWeilProperHigher_realization
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsProper p₀.left]
    (S : SfCompactSupportCoefficientAction l D.k (zlRealizationPrimeUnit D l hl) Ω
      (.ofIsProper (zlFiberMap D p₀)))
    (n : ℕ) (G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω)
    (H : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω)
    (e : (zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj H ≅
      ((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₀).rightDerived n).obj
        ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj G)) :
    Nonempty (H.obj.carrier ≅
      (constructibleTruncationCohomology
        (sfCommonStageStandardTStructure l (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left Ω D hl) (n : ℤ)).obj
          (S.system.functor.obj G.obj.carrier))
